ProrationPolicy.name: ProrationPolicy
ProrationPolicy.description: Represents the proration policy associated with a Product Selling Model Option that determines how a product's price is calculated based on subscription duration or billing periods.

ArePartialPeriodsAllowed.description: Indicates whether partial periods should be allowed for standard time periods.

LastReferencedDate.description: The date the proration policy was last referenced.

LastViewedDate.description: The date the proration policy was last viewed.

Name.description: The name of the proration policy.

ProrationPolicyType.description: The type of proration policy to be used.

RemainderStrategy.description: The type of remainder strategy to be used.

ProrationPolicy.accessRules: This object is available when Subscription Management is enabled.
